notes.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit has Launched %15 Off! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]For those of you who enjoyed the prologue you can now check out the full version of Koboo: The Tree Spirit at a discounted price![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/718190/Koboo_The_Tree_Spirit

Koboo: The Tree Spirit has finally released after 3 years of since my first Steam update! Thank you so much for all the support on Kickstarter, Discord, my family, my friends and the Steam community we have built up together! Also, I made sure to localize the price as best I could so you should be able to afford Koboo wherever you are in the world.

Let us know if you are experiencing any bugs or issues and we will work on a patch ASAP!

Thanks again and hope you enjoy it 
- Simon and Jerome

notes.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit Prologue - 0.14 Update - July 4, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]Weapon Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Leaf Axe’s attack speed has been increased by 31%, and its damage has been reduced by 20% to compensate. This is to make the big starter weapon a lot more intuitive and familiar for new players.
[*] Throwing Leaves and Thorns now have a magnetic effect when Koboo gets close enough. Hopefully it will make these beloved weapons of mine a lot less frustrating!
[*] Removed weapon lunging from standard melee weapons (Rocky Shield will still have its bash attack).
[*] Melee weapons will now freeze Koboo’s horizontal velocity to make aiming easier.
[*] Leaf Axe, Spear, and especially Fae Daggers now have larger hit boxes, making hits and crits with them easier.
[*] The Scorpion Venom weapon infusion has been reworked. Partly to give it more identity, partly to provide more build options, and partly for clarity.
[/list]

[h3]Magma Orb Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Magma Orb’s damage has been decreased by 18%. We hate to do this, but due to a miscalculation, we’ve noticed this weapon was significantly overtuned. Worry not! It’s still quite usable, and can often out DPS many of its alternatives! It just won’t be such a boss wrecker as before.
[*] Since the Magma Orb’s Inferno upgrade fully changes damage independent of the base version, those numbers have been decreased by 15% at Level 1, 18% at Level 2, and 12% at Level 3.
[*] Magma Orb’s Volcanic upgrade, however, was not so devastating. It’s difficulty of use needs to be better rewarded, so we’re increasing its damage bonus by 20% at every level.
[/list]

[h3]Tutorial Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Tutorial has been shortened and simplified. You no longer learn about abilities in the initial tutorial section.
[*] You can now switch between one of three weapons to test out on the dummy and take your preferred one to the upcoming fight.
[*] You will learn about abilities in a popup when you first acquire one.
[*] You learn about the comeback mechanic through a much nicer and clearer popup.
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Alterations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many Ranged attacks, including those of the Crossbow, Crossbow Knight, and Serpent Monk enemies will now have a lot more trouble aiming at Koboo when he’s behind them.
[*] Made Controller attacks (Like from Storm Mages and Blademasters) more transparent.
[/list]

[h3]Environment Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mushrooms won’t bounce the player as high as before, whether they bounce normally or with a slam attack.
[*] Koboo will now properly sink into bodies of water.
[/list]

[h3]Visual Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boss health bars will now fade out after they’re defeated.
[*] Koboo is now properly animated while underwater.
[*] Finished our Favor shop visual tweaks.
[*] Changed the Spikes and Axes into Mushrooms and made them bouncy!
[*] The tutorial boss will now fade the screen to black instead of white. No more flashbangs!
[/list]

[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Strike Where Facing” is now the default setting. Your settings will change to match this, but it can be turned off in the “Gameplay” settings
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further increased queue-related crash resistance.
[*] Koboo’s snake ability will now end upon death.
[*] Koboo can no longer receive an animal ability before acquiring a weapon in the tutorial, resulting in the unique effect of having two instances of the same animal ability.
[/list]

Thanks so much for the feedback!

- Simon and Jerome

notes.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit Prologue - 0.13 Update - June 29, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]Weapon Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Bludegeoning” upgrade from Leaf Axe has been completely replaced with a new one called “Fearless”. Check it out for yourself!
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] If only one weapon needs multiple upgrades when speaking to Mara, she will now upgrade it multiple times in a row, instead of needing to speak to her for each one.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Favour Shop has been changed visually to more clearly indicate the trading mechanic.
[*] Mushrooms now have a clear bouncing visual on use.
[*] Fixed the source of a lot of jittering players have experienced.
[/list]
[h3]Intuition[/h3]
[list]
[*] Taking a weapon in Mara’s shop while you already have one will now swap it out immediately, instead of opening the weapon swapping menu.
[*] Changed the name of the “Fourth Weapon Slot” upgrade to “Fourth Starter Weapon” for clarity.
[*] Added small text to the screen while Koboo is dying to inform players they can skip the death cutscene with the interact key.
[/list]
[h3]Sound and Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] The music will now stop during the tutorial once the Machine of Death appears.
[*] The music has been removed from the tutorial until enemies begin showing up.
[*] The combat music in the last room of the tutorial has been changed.
[*] Mushrooms now trigger a sound effect on use.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced crash risk caught by some unfortunate players.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Steadfast” upgrade from Spear wouldn’t properly block attacks. It should now work much more consistently!
[*] Can no longer accidentally skip the tutorial through menu saving.
[/list]
[h3]Typos[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a typo when interacting with garden plots.
[*] Fixed a typo in the poet fish’s dialogue.
[/list]

notes.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit - Prologue - 0.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Please let us know if you are experiencing any crashes or issues in the Steam discussions or in the comments here and leave us with as much details are possible so we can patch the errors as soon as possible!

Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bug fixed were tutorial can be skipped if you leave during it and play again
[*] Bug fixed were Mara repeated tutorial text in the main game world
[*] For some players, a patch to resolve a game crash when the player dies and restarts again
[/list]

Thank you for all the support so far on the launch it has gone well! We are looking for any and all feedback on the game in the Koboo: The Tree Spirit - Prologue Steam discussions forum.

Have a great day and enjoy!

- Jerome and Simon

notes.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit - Prologue is out on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Koboo: The Tree Spirit - Prologue (an free extended version of the demo) has now released on Steam! To support Koboo you can play it and leave your honest review and feedback on the game on Steam. 

I want to make Koboo: The Tree Spirit as fun as possible for players before it releases so this is a test of the core concept. Any and all feedback is welcome! 

Here is a roadmap for the full release of Koboo in case you are curious!
